data.long_meaning: Priti is a Sanskrit word that means love, devotion, or attachment. In Hindu mythology, Priti is also the name of the goddess of love and compassion. In Hindu tradition, Priti is also a virtue that is highly valued and sought after.

The name is often used as a term of endearment and is a source of inspiration for expressing deep feelings of love and affection.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural significance, the name Priti holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. By embracing the virtues associated with the name Priti, individuals can deepen their connection to the divine and cultivate a more meaningful spiritual practice.

historical_references.reference: Priti was the name of a renowned princess in ancient India who is said to have lived during the Gupta Empire (circa 4th to 6th century CE). She was deeply devoted to her husband and was known for her compassionate nature.
